messages:
Alex: Opened a PR to update the Optimize toolkit docs for batching, caching, and quantization profiles — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Need SME review and a small SDK snippet for Python + Node.
Maria: Thanks — can you paste a short changelist? I can route reviews.
Alex: Sure: - New section on request-level and continuous batching. - Cache primer with KV-prefix examples. - Quantization profiles + recommended tradeoffs. - Migration notes for v0.9 -> v1.0 config keys.
Jon: I can add the Python snippet for batching. Question: show both auto-batching config and manual batch_size example?
Maria: Show both, but keep auto-batching first and mark manual as advanced.
Sara: Also include a note about how prefix caching interacts with streaming responses — missed that in the draft.
Alex: Good call. I'll add a small note: "Prefix caching currently only caches completed tokens; streaming uses a transient KV and won't hit prefix cache until completion."
Tom (eng-runtime): Quick perf note: for 8-bit quant profiles we recommend testing with a 512 seq length; latency numbers in the PR table are from 256 seq, so either change table or annotate.
Alex: Updated table to say "measured at 256 seq unless noted" and added a second row for 512 with 8-bit profiles.
Jon: Python SDK snippet draft:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=REDACTED)
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood-optimize:latest",
  prompt="Summarize the doc",
  optimize={
    "batching": {"mode": "auto", "max_batch_tokens": 4096},
    "cache": {"prefix": "docs-v1", "ttl_seconds": 86400}
  }
)
print(resp.text)
```
Maria: Looks good. For Node please use the Promise style and show manual batch override too.
Jon: Node snippet added inline in PR.
Sara: For quant profiles I added three JSON examples: fp16, int8_2, int4_mix. Keep the int4 note explicit: "may alter output distribution; run evals".
Alex: I pushed a migration table for v0.9 -> v1.0 keys (batching.enabled -> batching.mode, cache.ttl -> cache.ttl_seconds).
Tom (eng-runtime): Left two inline comments about SDK param names in the client lib — small rename suggested: `optimize` -> `opt_settings` to avoid clash with other top-level opts.
Alex: Hmm ok. That would be a breaking change for older snippets. Maybe we add a top-of-doc compatibility note and show both keys for now.
Maria: I'll shepherd reviews — tagging @Sara and @Tom for final signoff. :eyes:
Sara: Reviewed, left a nit on the streaming/caching wording, resolved now. :thumbsup:
Tom (eng-runtime): Approved after tiny wording tweak.
Alex: Thanks all — will merge after CI.
docs-bot: PR #482 merged by Alex — docs site build scheduled.
Maria: Awesome, please add a short migration note in the release notes channel when the site is live.
Alex: Will do.
